classification_refinements.baseline_observable_assertions: V1 config SchedulerNamespaceStartWorkflowRPS=1 caps ten1s schedules to fewer than10 starts in5s; source explicitly says current CHASM lacks this scheduler-owned limiter.
classification_refinements.scheduler2_equivalent_obligation: The V1 limiter mechanism is implementation-specific, but scheduler2 needs an explicit namespace admission/rate-limit contract and a reproducible overload/recovery expectation. Executor concurrency1 is not rate limiting. Do not infer an approved no-limit divergence from current CHASM.
classification_refinements.dependent_gate: M3 C11/API behavior decision and test; M4 sustained load report
classification_refinements.evidence: source audit only; scheduler2 public execution pending

classification_refinements.baseline_observable_assertions: Public DescribeSchedule Info.StateSizeBytes is positive for a created paused schedule.
classification_refinements.scheduler2_equivalent_obligation: Adapt this public field assertion to scheduler2 Describe and define its byte-accounting scope. Internal P3.3 mutation-byte logs do not satisfy the public response contract.
classification_refinements.dependent_gate: M3 Describe response/projection; M4 growth measurements separately
classification_refinements.evidence: source audit only; scheduler2 public execution pending

classification_refinements.baseline_observable_assertions: One triggered workflow is reported COMPLETED, internal callback delivery metric fires, and native-start callback reattach metric remains absent.
classification_refinements.scheduler2_equivalent_obligation: Scheduler2 requires the completed-action public observation and real callback path. Exact metric names/backend tags and native versus recovery metric semantics need explicit mapping; internal result injection alone is insufficient.
classification_refinements.dependent_gate: M3 execution/callback/public observations and metric contract; no migration implementation implied
classification_refinements.evidence: source audit only; scheduler2 public execution pending

classification_refinements.baseline_observable_assertions: Three executions yield two action-delay samples tagged legacy; sample equals actual action time minus max(own scheduled time, prior blocking completion).
classification_refinements.scheduler2_equivalent_obligation: Legacy tag and refresh implementation stay baseline-specific. Scheduler2 must define equivalent desired/actual timing and correct backend metric attribution, or document a reviewed semantic divergence with a named reproduction; no absence exemption.
classification_refinements.dependent_gate: M3 timing/metric correspondence; M4 latency distributions separately
classification_refinements.evidence: source audit only; scheduler2 public execution pending

classification_refinements.baseline_observable_assertions: V1-created paused schedule has equal list Info and equal Count through V1 and CHASM contexts.
classification_refinements.scheduler2_equivalent_obligation: Scheduler2 typed List/Count must have a defined mixed-backend visibility policy and tests for identity/filtering/counts. Listing an existing schedule is not a silent execution fallback; neither cross-backend union nor isolation is presumed without the public routing contract.
classification_refinements.dependent_gate: M3 typed visibility, mixed-backend routing and no-fallback identity checks
classification_refinements.evidence: source audit only; scheduler2 public execution pending

classification_refinements.baseline_observable_assertions: Exact V1 scheduler workflow history remains unchanged after child timeout; Describe forces refresh, clears RunningWorkflows, then history advances.
classification_refinements.scheduler2_equivalent_obligation: Exact workflow-history events and refresh signal remain V1-only. Scheduler2 must expose correct running/terminal state after child timeout at a defined observation point, using its callback/recovery mechanism; no claim of eager or Describe-triggered refresh without a contract.
